sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 20 Cost.
Cost removal effect boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Support Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 50000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 50000
